Name: CHAOS_MATCHING_CORRECT_PARAM_ST
Description: Deep of Night scaling for enemies: the row named by the enemy's NpcParam Chaos Matching Correct ID gives one SpEffect per Deep of Night depth, and the one for the current depth is applied.
